subject: Add Privacy Policy, Terms of Business and Risk Disclosure pages
body:
New pages at /privacy, /terms and /risk, linked from the footer and from
the terms box on account opening. They describe what the site actually
collects and which services it uses. No legal entity, address, regulator
or governing law is named yet - add those once confirmed, and have
compliance review the text before funding goes live.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
